Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherloom
Description: Inspect Glamourer designs against the current character's carried and stored equipment.
Punchline: Plan outfits from your FFXIV wardrobe.
Changelog: Preview a design's enabled hairstyle whenever the game lists it for your character, including designs saved on a different clan or face. The preview log now records the equipped, requested and selected hairstyle IDs.
